description_en: Describes the compilation result of a custom regular expression rule

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to obtain the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html获取当前WAF实例的ID

parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地

schema.description_en: The compilation result of the custom regular expression rule

Result.description_en:
The compilation result. Valid values:

success: The rule is successfully compiled.

compiling: The rule is being compiled.

failed: The rule failed to be compiled
Result.description_zh:
编译结果，取值：
